headline: The desktop on the graphics chip, fast only when it needs to be

items.title: The desktop uses the graphics chip
items.text: The HDMI desktop now draws on the Q's own graphics chip instead of the processor, so it is smoother and leaves the processor free.

items.title: Fast only while it draws
items.text: The graphics chip speeds up to 384 MHz while something moves and drops to its lowest speed and voltage the moment the screen is still.

items.title: Updates finish cleanly
items.text: A system update no longer reports a failure when only an unused postmarketOS step complained, and the services restart as they should.
